# Cleanup edge case

Thanks for helping improve PasteLint.

GitHub Issues are public. Do not include confidential, client, medical, legal, personal, or sensitive text. Small anonymized examples are best.

## Tool used

Example: PasteLint Clean, Fix PDF Paste, Remove Hidden Characters, SecondDraft, SSML Builder

## Input type

Example: PDF paste, ChatGPT output, copied webpage text, TTS script, catalog record, IVR script

## What happened?

Describe what PasteLint did.

## What did you expect?

Describe the safer or clearer result.

## Small safe example

Paste only the smallest anonymized excerpt needed to show the issue.

## Browser/device, if relevant

Example: Chrome desktop, Safari mobile, Firefox desktop
